title: ZoomIt (12.0+) Record mode - Yellow border around screen remains in the captured video

judgment.rationale: The report identifies a standalone ZoomIt version comparison and a concrete recording symptom, but the cause has not been isolated.
evidence: The report describes a difference between the supplied ZoomIt 11.0 and 12.31 recording examples.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare saved whole-display and region recordings across the reported versions, keeping Windows capture settings unchanged.

issue_context.analysis: Use the same display and Windows capture settings for both versions; inspect the saved video separately from the on-screen indicator.
known_information: The report includes comparison clips and says the edge becomes visible after several frames.
inferences: Comparing whole-display and region recordings can distinguish a capture-mode difference from a version-wide difference.

information_gaps.information: Whether the edge appears in saved whole-display and region clips
information_gaps.why_needed: Separates a capture-mode issue from behavior shared by both modes.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record short clips in both modes and compare saved frames in an independent player.

issue_context.summary: The reporter sees a yellow edge in saved standalone ZoomIt 12.x recordings but not in an 11.0 recording.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the reported version comparison and available discussion. No runtime reproduction was performed.

reproduce.title: Verify reported ZoomIt behavior
reproduce.version_requirement: Standalone 12.31 compared with 11.0; compare PowerToys current main
prerequisites: Use an isolated Windows test system and keep Windows capture settings and permissions unchanged.
steps: Record the entire display with ZoomIt Record mode and save the video.
Play several frames in an independent player and inspect all four edges.
Repeat with region recording and with the supplied 11.0/12.31 version comparison.
reproduce.expected_result: The saved recording does not contain unintended edge pixels. Record whether the on-screen capture indicator is visible separately.

status.label: Verify whole-screen output against the supplied version pair and apply border policy consistently if
status.detail: The full-screen recording constructor still omits the capture-border suppression used for cropped recording; the supplied 11.0 versus 12.x clips give a concrete regression comparison.

next_action.label: Approve Disable the system capture border for ZoomIt recording
next_action.reason: Verify whole-screen output against the supplied version pair and apply border policy consistently if the configuration gap causes captured border pixels.

author: Rikk

fix_assessment.rationale: No implementable fix is established from the present evidence. First isolate whether the recorded border depends on whole-display versus region capture under the same Windows settings.
